source: Traced by hand in the audit (census-skill 10-routing-test.mjs) against the SKILL.md body below. Each request names the line where the route is given (anchor: that line, verbatim), the references the route tells the agent to read (whole files are what a client loads), and the reader verdict. Redo the trace whenever the body changes: see README.md.

requests.request: Here is /opt/acme/bin/licensed, a Linux ELF. Explain how it validates the licence key.
